status: frozen before sequence provider collection; snapshot holdout already collected, no prompt/gold/threshold change
asr_times: exact frozen reference/synthetic event times, additional event boundary ticks
provider_latency: recorded actual khipaa request latency, rounded up to next simulation tick; 800 ms deadline; identical cached body reuses same sampled outcome and latency
output_assumption: no LLM or TTS: empty generated text, 1200 ms synthetic duration, complete playback ACK; initial assistant duration from frozen sequence
stop_ack_assumption: next loop tick, cursor zero; this is not measured client/audio delay
sources: synthetic and source-reference projections only; no new Soniox/voice calls
primary_snapshot: final prefix+120ms, start after hypothetical floor release (assistant_speaking=false); separate stop probe while speaking where applicable
sequence: actual begin_decision/complete_decision/tick/playback on immutable engine copies; A/B/C/D under BOTH provider outcomes; every queried state paired across providers
timing_arm: fixed engine, prompt A, .47, one optional silence requery per input revision after 300/500/1000/2000ms only while idle pending, no in-flight request and no answer/clarify timer. External test driver resets last_decided; no production interface or timing changes
gold: unchanged from data-freeze; misses refer to no response.start by horizon, early includes start before opportunity or any start on retained floor/ack
scope: controller timing only, no acoustic-onset claims; source proxy labels retain uncertainty
